paragraphs.text: "Sleepy" Sovka is an orc from an unknown plane who traveled to Thunder Junction between 4562 and 4563 AR, where she has a bounty outstanding.

Sovka is a renowned outlaw on Thunder Junction . An orc with braided hair, she stands out in her Outcasters attire. She wears cactus and fur armor, characteristic of the Outcasters' naturalistic style. Known as "Sleepy," Sovka's nickname belies her reputation. Despite her seemingly relaxed demeanor, she is a cunning and effective outlaw. Her ability to remain undetected and strike when least expected makes her a formidable figure in the criminal world. Her reputation as a high-profile criminal is cemented by her ability to execute daring crimes and evade capture, which has put a bounty on her back.
